What nVent Electric says to expect

  • Full year 2026: sales growth and earnings per shareThe company now estimates reported sales growth for full-year 2026 of 48 to 49 percent versus prior guidance of 37 to 39 percent. This new guidance range reflects 38 to 39 percent organic sales growth versus prior guidance of 32 to 34 percent. The company now expects full-year 2026 EPS of $4.54 to $4.57 on a GAAP basis and adjusted EPS of $5.36 to $5.39, versus prior guidance of $4.29 to $4.39 on a GAAP basis and adjusted EPS of $5.00 to $5.10.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 30, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
